name: Karasuyama Kyouka
source: Minoru's childhood friend, very tomboyish and bossy.  As a self-proclaimed "super-realist", she provides a foil to Minoru's romanticism.  Despite this, Kyouka's also very protective of Minoru,and her reaction towards any girl coming near him borders on jealousy.
